param_input_item.param_description: Input volume, specified as a real nonsparse numeric or logical 3-D array.
Positive finite scalar resize factor applied to rows, columns, and planes.
Output volume size. Values are rounded to positive integer dimensions.
Supported options are 'Method' and 'Antialiasing'. The antialiasing option is parsed for compatibility.

param_output_item.param_description: Resized volume, returned with the same class as V.

description.p: imresize3 resizes volumetric image data by a scalar scale factor or to an explicit three-element output size.
The linear method uses separable trilinear interpolation. The nearest method uses nearest-neighbor sampling and preserves logical volumes exactly.

example_item.example_item_description: Resize a synthetic volume and display a central slice.
